# masamune_ai_openai

**Tag**: web, ui

## 简介

Plug-in to make OpenAI API available on Masamune Framework. API key registration is required separately.

## 官网

- 主页: https://mathru.net
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/mathrunet/flutter_masamune/tree/master/packages/masamune_ai_openai
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/masamune_ai_openai
